about: Pass 9 (2026-10-10): (1) LLM releases that pass 8 did not reach (its 'not reached' list plus releases 2026-09-15..10-10), and (2) popular local models that people run via ollama.com/library or the most-downloaded Hugging Face text-generation / image-text-to-text repos but that are missing from data/models.json. Every proposed model has verified run options (ollama tags checked on the tag page for quant/params/digest, or HF GGUF/safetensors files pinned by sha; sizes marked gb_estimated) and results from allowed ledger sources that land in multi-model runs: maker cards/reports with catalogued sibling sizes (by lab), and independent open-licensed leaderboards already in the ledger (EuroEval English, Open PT-LLM, Vectara HHEM, BFCL archive, Aider, AlpacaEval, SpeakLeash, Inception, BRIDGE, Midend, LiveBench, ...). Candidates only: nothing in data/ was edited.
